name: Homemade Soap Bar
description: A fragrant bar of homemade soap, shaped into a delicate flower. The scent of lavender and chamomile is faint but pleasant.

params.message: The soap is soft and intricately crafted. It smells faintly of lavender.
You lather your hands with the fragrant soap. The soothing scent of lavender and chamomile briefly warms the cold air.
